metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels over Taiwan increase between February 10-25, 2020 and April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code: The question is about comparing mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) levels over Taiwan between two time periods: 1. February 10-25, 2020 2. April 20-May 12, 2020 For NO₂ data, I should use the Sentinel-5P TROPOMI instrument, which has a NO₂ band. The relevant collection is 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2' which provides tropospheric NO₂ column number density. Strategy: 1. Define Taiwan geometry (I'll use a polygon covering Taiwan) 2. Get NO₂ data for both time periods 3. Calculate mean NO₂ for each period 4. Compare the values to see if there was an increase Data quality considerations: - Check if collections are empty (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist after processing (C2) - Validate the calculated values are reasonable (not NaN, within expected range for NO₂) For NO₂ tropospheric column, typical values range from near 0 to around 0.0005 mol/m², with polluted areas reaching higher. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const taiwan = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[119.0, 21.5], [123.0, 21.5], [123.0, 26.0], [119.0, 26.0], [119.0, 21.5]] ]); const period1_start = '2020-02-10'; const period1_end = '2020-02-25'; const period2_start = '2020-04-20'; const period2_end = '2020-05-12'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-5P NO2 data const no2_col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(period1_start, period1_end) .filterBounds(taiwan) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const no2_col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(period2_start, period2_end) .filterBounds(taiwan) .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); // Check collection sizes const size1 = no2_col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = no2_col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 (Feb 10-25): ${size1} images`); console.log(`Period 2 (Apr 20-May 12): ${size2} images`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Create mean composites for each period const mean_no2_1 = no2_col1.mean(); const mean_no2_2 = no2_col2.mean(); // Calculate mean NO2 values and pixel counts const stats1 = mean_no2_1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: taiwan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2 = mean_no2_2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: taiwan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean1 = stats1.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean').getInfo(); const count1 = stats1.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo(); const mean2 = stats2.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean').getInfo(); const count2 = stats2.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1: Mean NO2 = ${mean1 ? mean1.toFixed(6) : 'null'}, Pixels = ${count1}`); console.log(`Period 2: Mean NO2 = ${mean2 ? mean2.toFixed(6) : 'null'}, Pixels = ${count2}`); // Check for valid pixels if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (mean1 === null || mean2 === null || !isFinite(mean1) || !isFinite(mean2)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Validate reasonable NO2 range (mol/m²) if (mean1 < 0 || mean1 > 0.01 || mean2 < 0 || mean2 > 0.01) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Determine if NO2 increased const increased = mean2 > mean1; console.log(`Change: ${((mean2 - mean1) / mean1 * 100).toFixed(1)}%`); if (increased) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
